articles.title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap
articles.description: Apple says it will no longer ditch using its icloud.com domain for hiding people's email addresses.
articles.summary: Apple has decided to retain the Hide My Email feature, abandoning its previous plan to remove it. The company will continue to offer this feature for users who wish to maintain their email privacy.
points: Apple'in decision to retain the Hide My Email feature.
The feature will be available to users for privacy.
The company had previously planned to remove the feature.
articles.insight: The decision shows Apple's commitment to user privacy despite previous intentions to phase out features considered less critical for security.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
articles.description: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.
articles.summary: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip has outperformed current technology in both token generation per user and throughput per kilowterm in benchmark tests.
points: Jalapeño achieved more tokens per user on SemiAnalysis' InferenceX benchmark.
It also recorded higher throughput per kilowatt compared to existing state-of-the-art.
This performance could reshape energy efficiency standards in AI inference tasks.
articles.insight: Jalapeño's superior performance and energy efficiency could set new benchmarks in AI inference tasks, potentially influencing future AI hardware design.

articles.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal
articles.description: The funding, Gatik's largest so far, was led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies.
articles.summary: Self-driving truck startup Gatik has raised $200 million after securing a deal with PepsiCo, with the funding led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies. This funding round marks the largest for Gatik to date.
points: Gatik has secured a $200 million funding led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies after a deal with PepsiCo.
The self-driving truck startup specializes in transporting goods from warehouses to distribution centers.
The funding will enable Gatik to expand its fleet and invest in technology.
articles.insight: The substantial funding Gatik has secured is a significant endorsement of the potential of autonomous transportation technologies, which could lead to transformative changes in the logistics industry.

articles.title: Andy Dunn’s startup Pie becomes less of an events app and more of a social network
articles.description: The social app founded by Bonobos co-founder Andy Dunn is expanding beyond events with new digital homes for groups to connect, organize, and make plans.
articles.summary: Andy Dunn's startup, Pie, is transitioning from an events-focused app to a broader social network platform that allows groups to connect and organize. The platform introduces digital homes for various groups such as dads, newcomers to town, book clubs, and more.

articles.title: WhatsApp tightens account security with stronger two-step verification and more
articles.description: WhatsApp’s two-step verification previously relied on a six-digit PIN, but now users can choose a longer, alphanumeric password with special characters.
articles.summary: WhatsApp has enhanced its account security by allowing users to create longer, alphanumeric passwords with special characters for two-step verification, moving away from the six-digit PIN system.
points: WhatsApp' end users now have the option to select a stronger, alphanumeric password for two-step verification.
The platform has also improved the security of accounts by enabling users to set up custom security questions and answers.
WhatsApp has added a new feature that lets users verify the identity of their contacts.
articles.insight: The update indicates WhatsApp's commitment to enhancing security and user privacy, which may set a new standard for other communication platforms.
